cut: 3D v1 stills (21 Nov, en only). Owner, 21 Nov: 'Look into the Russian boat being attacked by drones next to helsinki' / 'Make the feeling a bit more ominous, with visuals and sounds. This is a war piece'. See plan/films/50-stable.md.
argument: Drone strikes on Russian ships have reached the Gulf of Finland, off Helsinki; Finland closes the eastern gulf's sky and sea again, while the official word is that the situation remains stable.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word

text.en: 11 Nov: / a Russian warship / is hit off Suursaari, / [40 km] / from Finland.

captions.source: Naro-Fominsk (Buyan-M missile ship), 11 Nov 2026, international waters near Gogland, roughly 40 km off the Finnish coast (Helsinki Times). Ukraine's SBU claims the strike (no weapon named, no damage shown); a senior Finnish official confirmed to Yle that Finland detected an attack near Gogland (yle.fi/a/74-20256496). The ship sailed to Kronstadt under its own power. Search summaries, 21 Nov. Suursaari is the Finnish name of the island (Russian: Gogland).

text.en: Finland’s / Defence Forces: / no immediate / [military threat].

captions.source: Finnish Defence Forces spokesperson after the 11 Nov strike: 'no immediate military threat to Finland'; declined details on location, timing or detection (Helsinki Times, others). Search summaries, 21 Nov.

text.en: 21 Nov. / A cargo ship / [on fire] / in the same gulf.

captions.source: Sparta II, bound for Kaliningrad, 21 Nov 2026. Leningrad Region governor Alexander Drozdenko: attacked by two drones in international waters three nautical miles from the Russian border, crew evacuating. Estonia's PPA rescue centre: reports of a fire and possible onboard explosions at 09:35. Not independently confirmed (ERR News 1610202715; TASS; UNITED24). Search summaries, 21 Nov.

text.en: Finland closes / the sky and sea / of the eastern gulf. / [Again].

captions.source: Finnish Defence Forces, 21 Nov 2026: a temporary aviation restriction area from 04:15 and a maritime restriction from 04:20 in the eastern Gulf of Finland, a precaution while preparing to counter possible drones (Yle 74-20258231; MTV; ESS/Uutissuomalainen 'jälleen'). Similar restrictions just over a week earlier, after a reported drone strike on Ust-Luga. Search summaries, 21 Nov.

text.en: The official word, / 11 Nov: / the situation / remains [“stable.”]

captions.source: Finnish Defence Forces after the 11 Nov strike: the security situation in the Baltic Sea 'remains stable' (Helsinki Times; others). Search summaries, 21 Nov. Quoted as their word, set against the record above.

post.en: 11 Nov: a Russian warship hit off Suursaari, 40 km from Finland (Ukraine claims it). Finland: the situation remains "stable." 21 Nov: a Russian cargo ship on fire in the same gulf (Russia says drones). Finland closes the eastern gulf's sky and sea, again.
